metadata.title: Complete Stock Market Data Sources Catalog

sources.name: Yahoo Finance (yfinance)
sources.notes: Unofficial, can break without notice. Dec 2025 broke for 48hrs.

sources.name: Finnhub
sources.notes: Best free tier for prototyping. 89ms median latency.

sources.name: Alpha Vantage
sources.notes: Free tier effectively unusable for portfolios. Returns passive-aggressive JSON when rate limited.

sources.name: Polygon.io
sources.notes: Free tier returns 2-year delayed data. $29/mo for real-time.

sources.name: Twelve Data
sources.notes: Silently returns stale data after ~400 daily requests. No error notification.

sources.name: Financial Modeling Prep (FMP)
sources.notes: Good fundamentals data. Free tier decent for small projects.

sources.name: IEX Cloud
sources.notes: Direct IEX exchange data. Some endpoints cost 100 messages vs 1.

sources.name: Tiingo
sources.notes: Clean data model. WebSocket streaming available.

sources.name: Quandl (Nasdaq Data Link)
sources.notes: Great for alternative and macroeconomic datasets.

sources.name: MarketStack
sources.notes: Free tier only 100 req/month. No intraday on free tier.

sources.name: Stooq
sources.notes: Good for bulk historical downloads. CSV format.

sources.name: NSE India (Direct)
sources.notes: Requires cookie warmup. Blocks automated requests frequently.

sources.name: BSE India (Direct)
sources.notes: REST API. Rate limits may apply.

sources.name: Zerodha Kite Connect
sources.notes: Brokerage API. ₹2000/month. Real-time data + execution.

sources.name: Upstox API
sources.notes: Brokerage API. Free with account. Real-time NSE/BSE.

sources.name: Angel One (SmartAPI)
sources.notes: Brokerage API. Free with account.

sources.name: ICICI Direct API
sources.notes: Brokerage API. Requires ICICI account.

sources.name: Groww API
sources.notes: Internal API. May change without notice.

sources.name: Moneycontrol API
sources.notes: Internal API. Comprehensive Indian market data.

sources.name: Trendlyne
sources.notes: Web scraping required. Great screeners and technical analysis.

sources.name: Tickertape
sources.notes: Screener and financial data platform.

sources.name: Screener.in
sources.notes: Excellent for Indian company financials and ratios.

sources.name: Downstox API
sources.notes: Free, unauthenticated, read-only JSON endpoints.

sources.name: Alpaca Markets
sources.notes: Free IEX feed. Paid SIP feed available. Good for algo trading.

sources.name: TD Ameritrade/Schwab
sources.notes: Brokerage API. Free with account. Comprehensive data.

sources.name: Interactive Brokers TWS
sources.notes: Professional-grade. Requires software installation. Market data subscriptions.

sources.name: TradingView (unofficial)
sources.notes: Internal API. Great for screening and charting data.

sources.name: Nasdaq Data Link (formerly Quandl)
sources.notes: WIKI dataset deprecated. Use other databases on platform.

sources.name: EOD Historical Data
sources.notes: Good global coverage. Insider transactions API.

sources.name: Yahoo Finance Historical
sources.notes: yfinance library. Returns adjusted closes. Can break anytime.

sources.name: Stooq
sources.notes: CSV downloads. Good for bulk historical data.

sources.name: Finnhub Historical
sources.notes: 1 year daily data on free tier.

sources.name: Alpha Vantage Historical
sources.notes: 20 years of daily data. Slow free tier.

sources.name: Polygon.io Historical
sources.notes: 5+ years historical on paid tiers.

sources.name: Investing.com
sources.notes: Web scraping required. Comprehensive global data.

sources.name: TradingView
sources.notes: Excellent charting. API access limited.

sources.name: Google Finance
sources.notes: No official API. Web scraping required.

sources.name: StockCharts
sources.notes: Good for technical analysis. Paid for advanced features.

sources.name: BigCharts (MarketWatch)
sources.notes: Basic charting. Historical data available.

sources.name: Netdania
sources.notes: Strong forex coverage. API available.

sources.name: FXStreet
sources.notes: Forex focused. Calendar and news.

sources.name: DailyFX
sources.notes: Forex and commodities focused.

sources.name: MarketWatch
sources.notes: Good for news and basic data.

sources.name: Wall Street Journal (WSJ)
sources.notes: Premium financial news. Limited free data.

sources.name: Bloomberg

sources.name: Reuters (Refinitiv)

sources.name: Financial Times (FT)
sources.notes: Premium financial data.

sources.name: CNBC

sources.name: Motley Fool

sources.name: Kiplinger

sources.name: Barron's

sources.name: BSE Historical (via bseindia lib)

sources.name: Finnhub Fundamentals

sources.name: InvestorPlace

sources.name: 24/7 Wall St

sources.name: NewsAPI

sources.name: OpenInsider

sources.name: InsiderMonkey

sources.name: MarketBeat Insider Trades
sources.notes: Free insider trade tracker. Email alerts available.

sources.name: Securities.io
sources.notes: Insider trading data and analysis.

sources.name: Finsider

sources.name: EdgarKit

sources.name: InsiderTrades.us

sources.name: SecApi.ai
sources.notes: Form 4, 144, board, compensation data.

sources.name: EODHD Insider Transactions

sources.name: Nasdaq Insider Activity

sources.name: FINRA

sources.name: SEC Form 13F Filings

sources.name: OpenInsider MCP Server

sources.name: CBOE DataShop

sources.name: CBOE All Access API
sources.notes: Complete CBOE data suite. Real-time and historical.

sources.name: OCC (Options Clearing Corp)

sources.name: Finnhub Options

sources.name: Polygon.io Options

sources.name: IEX Cloud Options
